figs.name: flemings-left-hand-rule-three-fingers-diagram
figs.alt: Flemings left hand rule diagram with thumb force, forefinger field and middle finger current
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing Fleming's left hand rule: forefinger along the field from N to S, middle finger along current, thumb giving the force on the conductor.
figs.after_h2: What Is Fleming's Left Hand Rule?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Fleming's left hand rule three fingers and force on a conductor between magnet poles</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fleming's Left Hand Rule: Three Fingers</text>
<rect x="20" y="58" width="370" height="400" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="190" cy="280" r="7" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<line x1="190" y1="280" x2="190" y2="130" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="204" y="120" font-size="19" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Thumb: Force F</text>
<line x1="190" y1="280" x2="350" y2="280" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="300" y="312" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Forefinger:</text>
<text x="300" y="336" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field B, N to S</text>
<line x1="190" y1="280" x2="95" y2="375" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="40" y="405" font-size="18" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Middle finger: Current I</text>
<text x="40" y="430" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">(toward you, out of page)</text>
<text x="205" y="90" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">All three at right angles</text>
<rect x="420" y="110" width="60" height="250" rx="6" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="710" y="110" width="60" height="250" rx="6" fill="#2563eb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="450" y="244" font-size="26" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">N</text>
<text x="740" y="244" font-size="26" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S</text>
<line x1="486" y1="150" x2="702" y2="150" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="486" y1="195" x2="702" y2="195" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="486" y1="290" x2="702" y2="290" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="486" y1="335" x2="702" y2="335" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<circle cx="595" cy="242" r="24" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>
<circle cx="595" cy="242" r="6" fill="#16a34a"/>
<line x1="595" y1="214" x2="595" y2="78" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="609" y="96" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Force up</text>
<text x="595" y="392" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field from N to S</text>
<text x="595" y="418" font-size="18" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Dot: current out of page</text>
<text x="400" y="486" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Remember FBI: thumb Force, forefinger B field, middle finger current I</text>
</svg>

figs.name: flemings-left-hand-rule-step-by-step-flowchart
figs.alt: step by step flowchart to apply the left hand rule and reverse motor force
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the four steps of the motor rule, then how reversing current or field reverses the force while reversing both leaves it unchanged.
figs.after_h2: How to Apply the Rule Step by Step
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Steps to apply Fleming's left hand rule and effect of reversing current or field</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Applying the Left Hand Rule Step by Step</text>
<rect x="120" y="58" width="560" height="66" rx="12" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="156" cy="91" r="17" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="156" y="97" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="190" y="85" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Find the field</text>
<text x="190" y="110" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">mark it from the north pole to the south pole</text>
<line x1="400" y1="124" x2="400" y2="138" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="120" y="140" width="560" height="66" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="156" cy="173" r="17" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="156" y="179" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="190" y="167" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Find the current</text>
<text x="190" y="192" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">mark conventional current, positive to negative</text>
<line x1="400" y1="206" x2="400" y2="220" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="120" y="222" width="560" height="66" rx="12" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="156" cy="255" r="17" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="156" y="261" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="190" y="249" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Set the fingers</text>
<text x="190" y="274" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">forefinger on the field, middle finger on the current</text>
<line x1="400" y1="288" x2="400" y2="302" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="120" y="304" width="560" height="66" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="156" cy="337" r="17" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="156" y="343" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="190" y="331" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Read the thumb</text>
<text x="190" y="356" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">the thumb now points along the force</text>
<line x1="400" y1="380" x2="400" y2="398" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,400.0 580.0,452 400,504.0 220.0,452" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="447.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reverse current</text>
<text x="400" y="470.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">or field?</text>
<polyline points="220,452 140,452 140,498" fill="none" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="150" y="438" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Only one</text>
<polyline points="580,452 660,452 660,498" fill="none" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="650" y="438" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Both</text>
<rect x="20" y="502" width="250" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145.0" y="524.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Force reverses</text>
<text x="145.0" y="547.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the wire moves the</text>
<text x="145.0" y="570.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">opposite way</text>
<rect x="530" y="502" width="250" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="655.0" y="524.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Force unchanged</text>
<text x="655.0" y="547.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">why a DC series motor</text>
<text x="655.0" y="570.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">keeps its direction</text>
</svg>

figs.name: flemings-left-hand-rule-force-torque-infographic
figs.alt: F equals BIL sin theta worked example giving 1 newton force and coil torque
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog with the worked examples: 0.5 T, 10 A and 0.2 m give a 1 N force, and a 50 turn coil at 0.4 T and 2 A gives 0.08 N m.
figs.after_h2: Force on a Conductor: F = BIL sin θ
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Force F = BIL sin theta and coil torque worked examples</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Motor Force and Coil Torque: Worked Examples</text>
<rect x="25" y="60" width="365" height="340" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="207" y="95" font-size="20" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Force on a conductor</text>
<rect x="50" y="112" width="315" height="48" rx="10" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="207" y="144" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">F = B × I × L × sin θ</text>
<text x="207" y="196" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">B = 0.5 T, I = 10 A</text>
<text x="207" y="230" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">L = 0.2 m, θ = 90°</text>
<text x="207" y="264" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">F = 0.5 × 10 × 0.2 × 1</text>
<rect x="95" y="335" width="225" height="48" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="207" y="367" font-size="22" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">F = 1 N</text>
<rect x="410" y="60" width="365" height="340" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="592" y="95" font-size="20" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Torque on a motor coil</text>
<rect x="435" y="112" width="315" height="48" rx="10" fill="#7c3aed"/>
<text x="592" y="144" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">F = N × B × I × L</text>
<text x="592" y="196" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">N = 50 turns, B = 0.4 T</text>
<text x="592" y="230" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I = 2 A, L = 0.05 m</text>
<text x="592" y="264" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">F = 50 × 0.4 × 2 × 0.05 = 2 N</text>
<text x="592" y="298" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Torque = 2 × 0.04 m</text>
<rect x="480" y="335" width="225" height="48" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="592" y="367" font-size="22" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T = 0.08 N m</text>
<rect x="25" y="420" width="365" height="96" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="207.5" y="450.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">θ = 90°</text>
<text x="207.5" y="473.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">current across the field,</text>
<text x="207.5" y="496.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sin 90° = 1, maximum force</text>
<rect x="410" y="420" width="365" height="96" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="592.5" y="450.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">θ = 0°</text>
<text x="592.5" y="473.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">current parallel to the field,</text>
<text x="592.5" y="496.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sin 0° = 0, no force</text>
</svg>
